Two kinds of project end up here. Some are finished, and the conclusion in them
still stands. Some were overtaken, because the question they asked got answered
somewhere else or stopped being a question. The card says which.

Nothing moved to get here. Each project keeps the folder it was always in and
the address it was always at, so a link to one of these pages still works. The
only change is that the card no longer sits on the
[Projects page](index.qmd).

::: {#archived}
